messages:
sam_w: Hey team — customer in staging reporting intermittent 403s after rotating a service key yesterday. They claim it's reproducible from their staging app. Gateway log shows req=rnL1x9-20260318-4f3b

sam_w: Gateway error body: {"error":"forbidden","msg":"token scope mismatch","code":403}

sam_w: Can we collect exact repro data? Asked them for a curl but want to confirm other artifacts: headers, decoded token claims, timestamps, region, provider ids.

elaine_support: Ask them for a curl with the exact Authorization header + x-org-id and x-project-id. Also request response headers. Quick example:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <SERVICE_KEY>" \
  -H "x-org-id: <org-id>" -H "x-project-id: <proj>" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings"
```
Elaine_support: Also ask for client-side timestamp of the call and any SDK versions. If they use our SDK, capture the environment var REDWOOD_ENV if present.

maria_auth: Important: if they rotated keys we sometimes see edge cache mismatch. Request the JWT payload (base64-decoded middle part) but warn them to redact any user PII. Example decode: `echo $TOKEN | cut -d'.' -f2 | base64 -d`

sam_w: Customer provided their curl (sanitized):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_staging_77Y" \
  -H "x-org-id: org-551" -H "x-project-id: proj-42" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```

sam_w: Response returned:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
x-request-id: 20260318-req-4f3b
content-type: application/json

{"error":"forbidden","message":"service key does not include project:proj-42","code":403}
```

jordan_sre: Pulled logs for req=rnL1x9-20260318-4f3b — incoming x-project-id=proj-42 but auth cache (2026-03-18T02:15:22Z) still maps that key to proj-7. Looks like config propagation lagged to edge eu-west-2. Ops pushed fix; propagation delay ~2m 40s.

jordan_sre: We should get the customer's timeline: when they created the new key, when their app retried, and the public IP/region of the caller so we can match to edge node.

sam_w: Requested from customer: exact curl (received), decoded claims (requested), client timestamp, caller IP, whether they run behind a proxy or CDN, and whether their process caches keys (some SDKs do). Also suggested app restart to flush local caches.

elaine_support: Share the debug-bundle script for them to run if they can (contains headers and optional packet capture):
```
curl -sS https://support.redwood.ai/debug-bundle.sh | bash -- -o debug-20260318-req-4f3b.tgz --request-id 20260318-req-4f3b
```

maria_auth: If they paste the decoded JWT claims (redact sub) I can quickly check `org` vs `x-org-id` and `projects` or `scopes` arrays for proj-42. If claims list only proj-7 then it's a token-versus-header mismatch.

sam_w: Customer returned decoded claims (redacted list):
- iss: https://auth.redwood.ai
- sub: svc:staging-01
- org: org-551
- projects: ["proj-7"]
- exp: 1710710000

sam_w: Confirmed token contains proj-7 only. They rotated and created a new key for proj-42 but their app still sends the old token. That would trigger the 403.

maria_auth: Confirmed root cause. Sent remediation steps: rotate to a key that includes proj-42 or change x-project-id to proj-7 temporarily. Also recommended restarting service to pick up updated credentials and enabling automatic key refresh in their deployment.

elaine_support: Sent step-by-step reply + debug-bundle link and suggested restart. Customer will confirm after restart. :thumbsup:

sam_w: Marking triaged for now. If 403 persists after restart ask for the debug bundle and we'll escalate to ops with edge node logs.

bot-deploy: Incident note — edge config propagation lag detected in eu-west-2 on 2026-03-18T02:15:22Z; propagation delay ~160s. Created ticket INC-4733.
